title: 才 vs 就 Step 4 · Conditions: 只要…就 vs 只有…才
description: 只要…就… = as long as (that's enough), 只有…才… = only if (nothing else works). Easy to mix up — and the meaning is very different.

points.title: 只要…就… = as long as
points.summary: One easy condition is enough: as long as A, then B.
points.body:
- **只要**你努力，**就**能学好。 As long as you work hard, you'll learn it.
- **只要**不下雨，我们**就**去。 As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: As long as you work hard, you'll learn Chinese well.

points.title: 只有…才… = only if
points.summary: Only this one condition works — a strict requirement.
points.body:
- **只有**多练习，**才**能说好。 Only by practising a lot can you speak well.
- **只有**他**才**知道密码。 Only he knows the password.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.

notes: 只有 pairs with 才, not 就.
因为 = because — doesn't fit a condition.
questions.translation: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go hiking.
Only by practising a lot can you speak fluently.

questions.prompt: What does 「{只要|zhǐyào}{有|yǒu}{时间|shíjiān}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{你|nǐ}。」 mean?
options: Whenever I have time, I'll come and see you.
I'll see you because I have time.
Only if I have time will I see you — otherwise never.
I have no time to see you.
questions.explanation: **只要…就** = as long as — an easy condition.
questions.translation: As long as I have time, I'll come and see you.

questions.prompt: What does 「{只有|zhǐyǒu}{他|tā}{才|cái}{知道|zhīdào}{密码|mìmǎ}。」 mean?
options: He only just learned the password.
As long as he knows the password, it's fine.
notes: Different meaning of 才 — here it's 只有…才.
如果不 = if not — the opposite.
questions.translation: He'll only agree if you go in person.

questions.prompt: 'As long as you're happy, that's fine.' Which sentence says so?
questions.explanation: **只要…就好** = as long as …, that's fine.
questions.translation: As long as you're happy, that's fine.

options: {只有|zhǐyǒu}{考|kǎo}{到|dào}{九十|jiǔshí}{分|fēn}，{才|cái}{能|néng}{拿|ná}{奖学金|jiǎngxuéjīn}。
{只要|zhǐyào}{考|kǎo}{到|dào}{九十|jiǔshí}{分|fēn}，{就|jiù}{能|néng}{拿|ná}{奖学金|jiǎngxuéjīn}。
notes: 只要…就 = 90 is enough; it doesn't rule out other ways.
questions.translation: Only with 90 points can you get the scholarship.

questions.explanation: 只要 pairs with **就**, 只有 with **才**.
questions.translation: As long as you come, I'll be happy.
Only Mr Wang can answer this question.

questions.prompt: Which pair fills both blanks: 只要…就 or 只有…才?
questions.explanation: **只要…就** = one easy condition is enough; **只有…才** = this condition and nothing else.
notes: Practice is the only way → 只有…才.
One press is enough → 只要…就…了.
Any free time at all is enough → 只要…就.
As long as you're happy → 只要你高兴就好.
The classic: 只有坚持才能成功.
Going in person is the only way → 只有…才.
